eips.title: Revert creation in case of non-empty storage
eips.summary: Legacy tests need reverting to pre-EIP-7610 expectations; collision behavior and block access list implications debated extensively.

moments.context: Maria Silva raised restoring pre-EIP-7610 legacy test expectations via legacytests PR #18.
Milen from Erigon explained the PR reverts tests to their state before EIP-7610, covering yellow paper plus EIP-684 behavior, and that restoring them caught a regression in Erigon.
Jochem noted that EIP-7610's conclusion arose partly because collision behavior had flip-flopped historically between reusing storage and clearing it.

eips.title: Revert creation in case of collision
eips.summary: Reverting legacy tests to align with yellow paper plus EIP-684 collision behavior was proposed as the path forward.

moments.context: Milen said the reverted legacy tests cover yellow paper plus EIP-684, which nullifies storage slots on collision, representing pre-existing behavior.
Spencer endorsed aligning undefined collision behavior with the yellow paper plus EIP-684 as an interim step before EIP-8253.

eips.title: Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts
eips.summary: Bumping nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts proposed to eliminate the collision edge case; Jochem wants it CFI'd for Hagota.

moments.context: Milen listed EIP-8253 as option 3 to get rid of the undefined BAL collision issue entirely.
Jochem noted EIP-8253 is PFI for Hagota, said he wanted to CFI it at the last ACD but that did not happen, and that it remains the plan.

eips.title: State-access gas cost update
eips.summary: A text clarification on EIP-8038 regarding self-destruct beneficiary gas charging was reviewed and approved as a non-spec change.

moments.context: FLCL from Nethermind explained the EIP text incorrectly assumes a 100 gas warm access charge for the former beneficiary in self-destruct, but no client does this; it is just a text clarification.
Jochem confirmed this is a text change, not a spec change; chat participants agreed.

eips.title: State Creation Gas Cost Increase
eips.summary: A PR adding a formal total state gas limit per transaction was merged; small spec update needed but no client behavior change.

moments.context: Jochem raised that Peville opened a PR to limit total gas for EIP-8037. Maria confirmed she merged it today, noting it formalizes an implicit limit without changing behavior.
Spencer confirmed it requires a small spec addition and said a test will be included in the upcoming official testnet release.
